flows.title: Create a job
steps: Navigate to Jobs > Jobs in the top menu bar and click + Create Job. Hovering over + Add in the top right and clicking Job does the same. The job wizard opens.
Fill in the job information: optionally a job template, then the Title, the Team and the Location.
Assign an interview plan, which sets the stages of the candidate pipeline, or click Skip.
In the Hiring Team section, select hiring team members from existing Ashby users and give them roles such as Hiring Manager or Recruiter.

flows.title: Create and publish a job posting
steps: Select Jobs and then Jobs from the top navigation bar, open the job, select its Job Postings tab, and click New Draft.
On the Description tab add the job description; on the Basic Info tab set the posting's title, whether it is Listed or Unlisted, and any third-party job boards.
On the Application Form tab, choose the application form candidates see.
Click Publish in the upper right corner. The job must be Open and the posting must have a description; a greyed-out button means something required is missing, and hovering over it says what.

flows.title: Add a user manually
steps: Navigate to Admin > Organization Setup > Employees. Only organization admins can do this.
Click New and enter the user's name and email address.
Click Create, and complete any other details in the user's profile.
The user first shows as a New Unprovisioned Employee. To activate them, click Actions on their profile, then Activate.
